fronts.name: Counter-offensive into Syria and Mount Hermon
fronts.commit_label: Counter-attack toward Damascus and retake Mount Hermon

cite.quote: Israel forces launched an offensive this morning at the Golan Heights cease-fire line, broke through enemy defenses and began advancing toward Damascus, the Israeli army spokesman reported tonight.
Israel paratroopers and soldiers of the Golani Brigade captured Syrian-held positions on Mt. Hermon in bitter fighting that started last night and continued this morning.

phases.name: 6 October: the surprise attack on the Golan and the Canal
mid-October: the counter-offensive and the Canal crossing

variants.note: Your cabinet ordered a pre-emptive air strike: the Egyptian and Syrian formations start the war weakened.
